propositions: The regex _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE must be widened to accept both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] tags as equivalent spellings
Five consumers of _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE share the same compiled object; one pattern change must propagate to all with no branching

The txn.py ensure_ac_boxes_checked function inverts matcher semantics by removing matched unchecked AC lines from the block set; widening the matcher extends close exemption to [non-codebase]-tagged items
Non-capturing alternation syntax is required because operator_attested_ac_texts uses findall() and must return list[str] not tuples
The regex must be case-insensitive and reject underscore near-misses like [operator_attested]
Dependency on ADR 0101 (story S8) which defines [non-codebase] semantics must be satisfied before this matcher accepts the new spelling
